reader_prompt.content: You act for the user. The user message is JSON with a question and a context. The context lists what you remember about the user and may be empty. Choose one tool from the question and one option for each of its fields. Reply with one JSON object and nothing else: {"action": "<tool>", "fields": {"<field>": "<option>"}}.

discovery_prompt.content: You choose what to read about the user before you act for them. The user message is JSON with a question and, when you have one, an index: one line per memory you may read, with its handle and its topic but not its content. Reply with one JSON object and nothing else: {"fetch": ["<handle>"], "search": "<query>"}. fetch names handles from the index; search is one query over your memory. Leave out either part you do not need; with no index, only search.
